title: Kinetix Ai Trading terminal
author: Alaminmasani
selftext:
Building an autonomous trading terminal in Python — looking for technical feedback.

I've been working on Kinetix, a trading system designed around multiple quantitative strategy engines rather than a single buy/sell indicator.

The architecture currently includes:

• Multiple strategy desks

• AI-assisted market analysis

• Real-time market monitoring

• Order-book and liquidity analysis

• Backtesting and walk-forward validation

• Risk management

• Automated execution

• Trading telemetry and logs

• GUI monitoring

• Telegram integration

The interesting part for me isn't simply getting an order executed.

It's designing the pipeline around:

Market scan → analysis → strategy confluence → validation → risk → execution → monitoring.

I'm documenting the development process and putting together a full walkthrough video.

I'd be interested in hearing from developers working with quantitative systems:

Would you prioritize adding more strategies, improving the validation layer, or making the decision pipeline more explainable?
